findings.text: S-1 AC4 uses the vague fixture 'dates far apart in the past'. It is checkable, but a concrete precondition, such as appointments older than any plausible window, would make the test setup clear.

rubric_items.reason: Stories trace every known REQ (REQ-1 to REQ-8) and the assumed REQ-9. S-1 covers REQ-1/2/3/9, S-2 covers REQ-4/5/6 and S-3 covers REQ-7/8.
Each story has one outcome: showing the counts, the exclusion and zero rules, and no regression. S-2 depends on S-1's Visit summary existing, so the stories are not fully independent.
Every AC uses Given/When/Then and can be checked. S-3 AC3 ('every section other than...') and S-1 AC4 ('dates far apart') are loosely bounded but can still be checked.
The only literal value is 0, and it comes from REQ-6. The no-date-window rule is marked as assumed REQ-9 and backed by Q-03.
Status terms match the glossary and read clearly. The AC wording in the front matter and the body differs slightly for S-2 AC1/AC2 and S-3 AC1-AC3.
